senses.gloss: m. (ספר, cmp. אֶסְפּוֹר) Espar, a Hebrew name for Sestertius (cmp. אִיסָר &c.). .
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 2:9">Maas. Sh. II, 9</cite> (Ms. M. <cite ref="R00759"><he>אצטרי</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="A01521"><he>אִיסְתִּירָא</he></cite>, Asheri <he>אצפרי</he>); <cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 1:10">Eduy. I, 10</cite> (he must exchange the fourth Denar) <he>ארבעה א׳ כסף</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ארבע</he>) for four sestertii. [Oth. opinions (v. comment.), ἄσπροι, supposed to be worth one fifth of a Denar. There is, however, no evidence of ἄσπροι being used in this sense in the days of the Mishnah.]
